title: polisi for privacy
html:
Dis polisi go start to work from 15 February 2026. Abeg note say we go dey update dis privacy statement from time to time.

Kyber value your privacy and we don commit to protect your personal data. Dis Privacy Policy dey explain how we dey collect, use, and protect your information wen you visit our website.

Information wey we dey collect

  • Personal Identifiable Information (PII): Like your name, email address, and phone number wen you fill contact form.
  • Data wey no be personal: Like your IP address, di kain browser wey you dey use, and di pages wey you visit, for analytics purpose.

How we dey use your information

  • To provide our services and make dem beta
  • To reply questions or request for support
  • Customer Support : To give customer service and support, including to reply your questions, solve any wahala wey you get, and make your experience beta.
  • Marketing and oda communication wey relate to am : To send you news about Kyber, special offers, or general information about our products and services, but only if you already get relationship wit us or you don agree to receive dis kain communication. You get di right to stop marketing messages anytime.

We no go use Personal Data for any purpose wey no match di purposes wey we list for up without your consent.

How we dey share your information

We value your privacy and we dey handle your Personal Data wit care. We no dey sell or rent your personal information give third parties for dia own marketing purposes. But, we fit share information about you for dis situations wey follow, or as dis Privacy Policy describe am for oda place:

  • Service Providers : We fit share your information wit third-party service providers and partners wey dey do services for our behalf or wey dey help us run di Service. You fit get di list anytime if you ask for am through dpo@kyber.media.
  • Affiliates and company transactions : We fit disclose your information give our subsidiaries, parent company, or oda affiliates as e dey necessary to make our operations run smooth (for example, if we get international branches). If merger, acquisition, due diligence for financing, reorganization, bankruptcy, receivership, sale of company assets, or any oda business transaction happen, dem fit transfer your Personal Data as part of dat deal. We go give you notice before we transfer your Personal Data and before e go fall under anoda privacy policy.
  • To obey di law : We fit disclose your Personal Data if law require us to do am or as response to valid request from public authorities (for example, court order, subpoena, or demand from goment). We go only share di information wey dey necessary and, wen law allow am, we go inform you about dat disclosure.
  • To protect rights and safety : We fit disclose information if we believe say e dey necessary or appropriate to protect di rights, property, or safety of Twenty, our customers, our workers, or oda pipo. Dis one include to exchange information wit oda companies and organizations to prevent fraud, detect spam/malware, or for oda similar purposes.

Apart from di purposes wey we list for up, we no go transfer your Personal Data give any third party without your knowledge, and we no dey share personal information wit third parties for dia own direct marketing use. If we ever need to share your data for way wey different well-well, we go update dis Privacy Policy and notify you as e dey required.
